messages.subject: [NMOF-news] NMOF 0.25-2 on R-Forge
messages.body_plain:
v0.25-2  (2012-06-17)

   o Small changes in the vignettes (mostly layout).

   o In 'TAopt', 'LSopt': if 'x0' is not a function, it is initialised
     with 'eval(x0)'; thus, it can be an expression.

   o Several minor internal changes.


-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://nmof.net

messages.subject: [NMOF-news] Slides for Rmetrics Workshop / News accessible through Gmane
messages.subject_clean: [NMOF-news] Slides for Rmetrics Workshop / News accessible through Gmane
messages.body_plain:
(1) The slides and the R code of the tutorial at the '6th R/Rmetrics 
Meielisalp Workshop & Summer School on Computational Finance and 
Financial Engineering' are now available from
http://enricoschumann.net/NMOF.htm

For more information about the workshop, see https://www.rmetrics.org/


(2) Thanks to the people at Gmane, you can now read NMOF-News with your 
favourite newsreader. More Information is here:

http://dir.gmane.org/gmane.comp.finance.nmof.announce



-- 
Enrico Schumann
Lucerne, Switzerland
http://nmof.net
